Subject: RE: VAT treatment guidance — Greenhaven / Redwood

Hi all,

We looked at the details you shared and confirm: when a UK-registered (GB) entity is billed by a non-UK supplier for software services, reverse-charge applies assuming the supply is B2B and the customer provides a valid VAT registration. The supplier should not charge VAT and instead include a reverse-charge note on the invoice.

Suggested invoice notice: "Reverse-charge: VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 44, Council Directive 2006/112/EC. Customer VAT ID: GB987654321."

Happy to sign off on the language if you want us to provide a short confirmation letter for Greenhaven’s auditors (for a small fee) — let us know.

Regards,
TaxComply Ltd.
billing@taxcomply.io

--
